pages.html:
Xi'an Sheerherb Biological  Technologies Co. Ltd and its affiliates (collectively, "Sheerherb", "we", "us", and "our") respect your privacy. Please read the following to learn more about our Privacy Policy ("this Policy"). This Policy applies to Sheerherb websites, products, and services that display or provide links to this Policy.

This Policy describes how Sheerherb processes your personal data, but it may not address all possible data processing scenarios. Sheerherb may inform you of product- or service-specific data collection through supplementary policies or notices provided before collection.

This Policy describes:

1. How We Collect & Use Your Personal Data

2. Cookies & Similar Technologies

3. How We Disclose Personal Data

4. How to Access & Control Your Personal Data

5. How We Protect Your Personal Data

6. How We Process Children's Personal Data

7. Third-Party Providers and Their Services

8. International Transfers of Your Personal Data

9. Updates to This Policy

10. How to Contact Us

1. How We Collect & Use Your Personal Data

Personal data means any data that, either on its own or jointly with other data, can be used to identify a natural person. You directly provide us with such data when you use our websites, products, or services, or interact with us by, for example, creating a Sheerherb account or contacting us for support. We may also obtain data by recording how you interact with our websites, products, or services. For example, we may use technologies like cookies or receive use data from software running on your device. As permitted by law, we may also obtain data from public and commercial third-party sources, for example, purchasing statistics from other companies to support our services. The personal data we collect includes name, gender, enterprise name, job position, postal and email addresses, phone number, login information (account and password), photos, and certificate information, etc., depending on how you interact with Sheerherb, for example, the website you visit or the products and services that you use. We also collect the information you provide to us and the content of messages you send us, such as the query information you provide, or the questions or information you provide for customer service support.

Before using Sheerherb’s products or services, you may need to provide personal data.  In some cases you may be able to opt not to disclose your personal data to Sheerherb. However, not providing Sheerherb with certain data may mean that we cannot provide you with certain products or services or respond to an issue that you have raised.

We may use your personal data for the following purposes:

  • Creating an account.
  • Fulfilling your transaction or service requests, including fulfilling orders; delivering, activating, or verifying products or services; providing training and certification; managing and processing training and certification exams; participating in onsite or virtual activities; fulfilling your requests for changes or providing you with the requested information (such as marketing materials for products and services, and white papers); and providing technical support.
  • Contacting you with your consent; sending you information about products and services that may interest you; inviting you to participate in Sheerherb activities (including promotional activities), market surveys, or satisfaction surveys; or sending you marketing information. If you do not want to receive these types of information, you can opt out at any time.
  • Sending you important notices, such as installation of and updates to operating system or application.
  • Providing you with customized user experience and content.
  • Qualifying and managing suppliers and business partners, and communicating or working with suppliers and business partners.
  • Improving our products and services through internal audits, data analysis, and research.
  • Analyzing the efficiency of our business operations and evaluating market share.
  • Troubleshooting when you send us error reports.
  • Synchronizing, sharing, and storing the data you upload or download and the data needed for the uploading and downloading.
  • Ensuring the security of our products, services and customers or users, executing and improving our loss prevention and anti-fraud programs.
  • Complying with and enforcing applicable legal requirements, industry standards and our policies.

Sheerherb may also collect and use non-personally identifiable information (Non-PII). Non-PII is information that cannot be used to identify a particular individual. For example, Sheerherb will collect statistical data, such as the numbers of visits to its website. We collect this data to understand how users use our websites, products, and services so that we can improve our services and better satisfy your needs. Sheerherb may collect, use, process, transfer, or disclose non-PII for other purposes at its own discretion.

We will endeavor to isolate your personal data from non-PII and ensure that the two types of data are used separately. If personal data is combined with non-PII, it will still be treated as personal data during processing.

Sheerhreb will process your personal data following the requirements of applicable laws on an appropriate legal basis, including:

  • Processing your personal data to fulfill the contract when responding to a transaction or service request;
  • Processing your personal data with your consent;
  • Processing based on the legitimate interests of Sheerherb or a third party when we use your personal data to contact you, conduct marketing or market surveys, improve our products and services, execute and improve our loss prevention and anti-fraud programs, and other purposes. Legitimate interests include enabling us to more effectively manage and operate our business and provide our products and services; protecting the security of our businesses, systems, products, services, and customers; internal management; complying with internal policies and processes; and other legitimate interests described in this policy;
  • Processing your personal data as necessary to comply with and fulfill legal obligations.

2. Cookies & Similar Technologies

2.1 Cookies

To ensure our website works correctly, we may at times place a small piece of data known as a cookie on your computer or mobile device. A cookie is a text file stored by a web server on a computer or mobile device. The content of a cookie can be retrieved or read only by the server that creates the cookie. The text in a cookie often consists of identifiers, site names, and some numbers and characters. Cookies are unique to the browsers or mobile applications you use, and enable websites to store data such as your preferences or items in your shopping cart.

Like many other websites or Internet service providers, Sheerherb uses cookies to improve user experience. Session cookies are deleted after each visit, while persistent cookies remain in place across multiple visits. Cookies allow websites to remember your settings such as language, font size on your computer or mobile device, or other browser preferences. This means that a user does not need to reset preferences for every visit. On the contrary, if cookies are not used, websites will treat you as a new visitor every time you load a web page. For example, if you are redirected to another web page from a website you are already logged in to and then return to the original website, it will not recognize you and you must log in again.

Sheerherb will not use cookies for any purposes not stated in this Policy. You can manage or delete cookies based on your own preferences. For details, visit AboutCookies.org. You can clear all the cookies stored on your computer, and most web browsers provide the option of blocking cookies. However, by doing so, you have to change the user settings every time you visit our website. Find out how to manage cookie settings for your browser here:
Internet Explorer
Google Chrome
Mozilla Firefox
Safari
Opera

2.2 Web Beacons and Pixel Tags

In addition to cookies, we may also use other similar technologies on our websites such as web beacons and pixel tags. For example, when you receive an email from Sheerherb, it may contain a click-through URL that links to a Sheerherb web page. If you click the link, Sheerherb will track your visit to help us learn about your preferences for products and services and improve our customer service. A web beacon is a transparent graphic image embedded in a website or in an email. We use pixel tags in emails to find out whether an email has been opened. You can unsubscribe from the Sheerherb mailing list at any time if you do not want to be tracked in this manner.

By using our website, you consent to the use of cookies, web beacons and pixel tags as described above.

3. How We Disclose Personal Data

Sheerherb shares your personal data with other partners, as described in this Policy, when services are provided by partners authorized by Sheerherb. For example, when you make an online purchase from Sheerherb, we must share your personal data with the logistics provider to arrange shipment or a partner to provide services. In addition, as a global company, we may share personal data with Sheerherb affiliates and subsidiaries.

To comply with applicable laws or respond to valid legal procedures, Sheerherb may also disclose your personal data to law enforcement or other government agencies. If Sheerherb is involved in a restructuring, merger & acquisition, or a bankruptcy or liquidation lawsuit in a given jurisdiction, your personal data may be disclosed in connection with the transaction. Sheerherb may also disclose your data when appropriate, for example, to execute Terms and Conditions, when we believe disclosure is necessary or appropriate to prevent physical harm or financial loss, or when it is in connection with an investigation of suspected or actual illegal activity.

4. How to Access & Control Your Personal Data

It is your responsibility to ensure that all personal data submitted to Sheerherb is correct. Sheerherb is dedicated to maintaining the accuracy and completeness of personal data and keeping the data up-to-date.

To the extent required by applicable law, you may (i) have the right to access certain personal data we maintain about you, (ii) request that we update or correct inaccuracies in that data, (iii) object or restrict to our use of your personal data, and (iv) ask us to delete your personal data from our database. To exercise these rights, please click here to give your feedback online. Your written request may be required for security. We may decline the request if we have reasonable grounds to believe that the request is a fraudulent, unfeasible or may jeopardize the privacy of others.

If allowed by applicable laws, you have the right to withdraw your consent at any time when Sheerherb processes your personal data based on your consent. However, withdrawal does not affect the legitimacy and effectiveness of how we process your personal data based on your consent before the withdrawal is made; nor does it affect any data processing based on another justification other than your consent.

If you think that the way we process your personal information does not comply with applicable data protection laws, you can contact the relevant competent data protection authority. You can obtain the information for contacting EU data protection authorities at http://ec.europa.eu/justice/article-29/structure/data-protection-authorities/index_en.htm.

5. How We Protect and Retain Your Personal Data

The security of your personal data is important to us. We use appropriate physical, management, and technical measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, disclosure, use, modification, damage, or loss. For example, we use cryptographic technologies for data confidentiality, protection mechanisms to prevent attacks, and access control mechanisms to permit only authorized access to your personal data. We also provide training on security and privacy protection for employees to raise their awareness of personal data protection. Sheerherb is committed to protecting your personal data; however, please note that no security measure is perfect.

We will retain your personal information for no longer than is necessary for the purposes stated in this Policy, unless otherwise extending the retention period is required or permitted by law. The data storage period may vary with scenario, product, and service. The standards Sheerherb uses to determine the retention period are as follows: the time required to retain personal data to fulfill business purposes, including providing products and services; maintaining corresponding transaction and business records; controlling and improving the performance and quality of products and services; ensuring the security of systems, products, and services; handling possible user queries or complaints and locating problems; whether the user agrees to a longer retention period; and whether the laws, contracts, and other equivalencies have special requirements for data retention; etc. We will maintain your registration information as long as your account is necessary for service provision. You can choose to deregister your account. After you deregister your account, we will stop providing you with products and services through your account and delete your relevant personal data, provided that deletion is not otherwise stipulated by special legal requirements.

6. How We Process Children's Personal Data

Our websites, products and services are primarily intended for adults. A child must not create a Sheerherb account without the consent of a parent or guardian. If a child's personal data is collected with prior parental consent, we will only use or disclose the data as permitted by law, with the explicit consent of the child's parents or guardians, or when necessary for the protection of the child. If we accidentally collect a child's personal data without verified prior consent from the child's parents, we will attempt to delete the data as soon as possible.

7. Third-Party Providers and Their Services

To ensure a positive user experience, you may receive content or web links from third parties other than Sheerherb and its partners ("third parties"). Sheerherb does not have the right to control such third parties, but you can choose whether to use the links, view the content and/or access the products or services provided by third parties.

Sheerherb cannot control the privacy practices and data protection policies of third parties that are not subject to this Policy. When you submit personal information to such a third party, please read and refer to the privacy protection policy of the third party.

8. International Transfers of Your Personal Data

As a global company, your personal data collected by Sheerherb may be processed or accessed in the country/region where you use our products and services or in other countries/regions where Sheerherb or its affiliates, subsidiaries, service providers or business partners have a presence. These jurisdictions may have different data protection laws. In such circumstances, Sheerherb will take measures to ensure that data is processed as required by this Policy and applicable laws, which includes when transferring the data subject’s personal data from the EU to a country or region which have been acknowledged by the EU commission as having an adequate level of data protection, we may use a variety of legal mechanisms, such as signing standard contractual clauses approved by the EU Commission, obtaining the consent to the cross-border transfer of a data subject in the EU, or implementing security measures like anonymizing personal data before cross-border data transfer. You can click here to obtain a copy of the EU’s standard contractual clauses.

9. Updates to This Policy

Sheerherb reserves the right to update or change this Policy at any time. We will release the latest Privacy Policy on this page for any changes. If major changes are made to the Privacy Policy, we may notify you through different channels, for example, posting a notice on our website or sending you direct notification.

10. How to Contact Us

If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us through the inquiry form. If you have any privacy complaints or issues, and want to contact Sheerherb Data Protection Officer (DPO), please click here.

Where your personal data is processed by Sheerherb in accordance with this Privacy Policy, the Sheerherb entity that responds to your request, contacts you, provides you with products or services, or has signed or is about to sign a contract with you is the controller of the related personal data. You can click here to obtain the contacts of Sheerherb entities.

Our liposome technology helps sheerherb ™ Maintain its advantages.

Available in bulk powder form, encapsulated or private label

Liposome is an artificial membrane. In the water, the hydrophilic head of the phospholipid molecule is inserted into the water, and the hydrophobic tail of the liposome extends into the air. After stirring, a spherical liposome with a double layer of lipid molecules is formed, with a diameter ranging from 25 to 1000 nm. Liposomes can be used for transgenics or prepared drugs, taking advantage of the fact that liposomes can fuse with cell membranes to deliver drugs into cells.

Micropellets technology—sheerherb™

Pellets are spherical or quasi-spherical solid dosage forms with a diameter ranging from 0.5 to 1.0 mm. They can also be packed into capsules, pressed into tablets, or made into other preparations. Pellets are a multi-unit oral dosage form, usually consisting of dozens to hundreds of pellets for a single dose. It can be made into different types of pellets such as sustained-release and enteric-coated.

Special formulations of drugs can be made by microencapsulation with different capsule materials, including enteric coated formulations, sustained-release formulations, and controlled release formulations.

What Is Release Micropellets?

  • Sustained release micropellets technology is a dosage form technology designed to release active ingredients gradually. This technology allows a drug or nutrient to be released at a predetermined rate over a specific period of time, thus maintaining a constant concentration in the bloodstream and reducing the frequency of dosing and side effects.
  • In dietary supplements, extended-release micropellets typically consist of a capsule containing a number of tiny particles with different coatings that are able to dissolve gradually at different points in time, resulting in a sustained release of their active ingredient. This design allows for an extended release of the ingredient, for example for 8 hours. The release rate of extended-release micropellets can also be customized to ensure optimal results and convenience.

Advantages of release micropellets

  • Small particle size: usually less than 1 mm, not limited by gastric pyloric closure, stable transport rate, little influence by food, and small pharmacokinetic differences.
  • High utilization: large specific surface area reduces gastrointestinal irritation and improves bioavailability.
  • Multi-unit release: the capsule contains hundreds to thousands of independent release units, abnormal release does not affect the overall effect, to ensure the stability of sustained release.
  • Free combination: can be mixed with different release rates of micro-pills, adjust the overall release rate, more rational pharmacokinetics.
  • Convenient to take: the micro-pills can be taken alone or mixed with food, suitable for those who have difficulty in swallowing, to improve compliance.

pages.html:
What are liposomes？

Liposomes are tiny vesicles composed of a bilayer of phospholipids with a structure similar to a cell membrane. Phospholipid molecules have an amphiphilic property, hydrophilic at one end and lipophilic at the other, which enables liposomes to form a bilayer membrane structure that encapsulates and protects their internal contents, such as drugs and nutrients.

Main features of liposomes

High histocompatibility: Phospholipid bilayer structure similar to cell membrane, reducing immune rejection.
Low toxicity: composed of natural phospholipids, suitable for long-term use with few side effects.
Strong encapsulation ability: effectively encapsulates hydrophilic and lipophilic substances, such as drugs and proteins.
Controlled release: Regulate the release rate of active ingredients to achieve slow release or targeted delivery.


Hydrophilicity and lipophilicity

Hydrophilicity: The aqueous core of liposomes encapsulates hydrophilic nutrients, such as water-soluble vitamins and drugs, protecting them from destabilization in the digestive tract and facilitating their efficient transport to the small intestine.
Lipophilicity: The phospholipid bilayer of liposomes protects lipophilic substances, such as fat-soluble vitamins and drugs, from destruction in the digestive tract and facilitates their direct entry into cells and tissues through the liposome structure.

Descriptions of Liposomal Vitamin c Softgel

Liposomal vitamin C is an enhanced form of vitamin designed to improve nutrient absorption and utilization within the body. Liposomes are small spherical cells composed of fatty acids extracted from sunflowers or soybeans, with the outer layer primarily consisting of phospholipids. Liposomes also contain an inner compartment composed of water and water-soluble active ingredients. Water-soluble components such as vitamin C are protected within the inner compartment of the liposome structure. This structure helps to prevent water-soluble components from being degraded during digestion, thereby enhancing their stability and bioavailability in the body.

N-Acetyl Cysteine (NAC) Capsules Supplement is a product that provides cysteine in a supplemental form. Cysteine is an amino acid that helps the body produce and use protective antioxidants. It is considered a "semi-essential amino acid" because the body can produce some NAC from other amino acids such as methionine and serine. It is possible to get enough NAC in your diet to meet your daily needs, but getting higher amounts may be beneficial for some people.

Biological age is based on the cellular age of one's health, and the essence of anti-aging is to reduce biological age. Longevity experts have summarized five supplements suitable for combating aging, some of which can be obtained through food as well. Urolithin A Anti-Aging Supplements[/caption] 01

Urolithin A Anti-Aging Supplements

Urolithin A is a natural metabolite with antioxidant and anti-proliferative properties. Nutritionists at Southeast University in the United States have found that using urolithin A as a dietary intervention can delay the aging process and prevent the development of age-related diseases. Urolithin A promotes mitochondrial autophagy, helping to recycle damaged mitochondria and maintain cell vitality. Although urolithin A is not directly obtained from the diet, compounds such as ellagic acid and ellagitannins found in nuts, pomegranates, grapes, and other berries are metabolized by intestinal microbes to produce urolithin A. 02

Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) Anti-Aging Supplements

Research published in the journal "Aging and Disease" by clinical molecular biologists at the University of Oslo in Norway shows that the consumption of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) is associated with aging and serves as the basis for various age-related diseases such as metabolic disorders, cancer, and neurodegenerative diseases. NMN is a bioactive nucleotide that can elevate NAD+ levels. It is worth noting that due to ongoing investigations by pharmaceutical companies, the FDA recently decided that NMN cannot be sold in the United States as a dietary supplement. In contrast, nicotinamide riboside (NR), a derivative of vitamin B3, is a similar functional nutritional supplement available in the United States. NMN is naturally present in the body but decreases with age. Some fruits and vegetables rich in NMN include avocados, broccoli, cabbage, edamame, and cucumbers. 03

Spermidine Anti-Aging Supplements

Spermidine is a naturally occurring polyamine that has garnered attention in recent years for its potential to prolong lifespan and increase healthy lifespan. Researchers at Kyoto Prefectural University of Medicine in Japan published a study in "Scientific Reports" showing that normal aging processes decrease the concentration of endogenous spermidine in the body. However, this phenomenon was not observed in centenarians, who had relatively high concentrations of spermidine in their bodies. Spermidine promotes autophagy. Foods with high spermidine content include whole grains, seaweed, shiitake mushrooms, nuts, bracken, and purslane. 04

Fisetin Anti-Aging Supplements

Senescent cells are cells that deteriorate with age and release inflammatory molecules into surrounding tissues. Fisetin significantly affects the aging process by reducing the accumulation of these dysfunctional cells and improving overall health. Geneticists at Tianjin Medical University found that fisetin can reverse premature aging signs in telomerase-deficient mice. Fisetin is found in various fruits (strawberries, apples, mangoes, persimmons, kiwis, and grapes), vegetables (tomatoes, onions, cucumbers), nuts, and wine. 05

Curcumin Anti-Aging Supplements

Curcumin is an active compound found in turmeric with anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Experimental biologists at the Polish Academy of Sciences found that curcumin can reduce aging symptoms and delay the progression of age-related diseases directly involving senescent cells, thereby extending lifespan. In addition to turmeric, foods high in curcumin content include ginger, garlic, onions, black pepper, mustard, and curry. While these supplements have the potential to prolong lifespan, it's advisable to consult a doctor before taking them. posts.html: With the continuous pursuit of efficacy in beauty skincare products, technological advancements have brought about many innovative solutions to the skincare industry. Among these innovative technologies, liposome encapsulation technology undoubtedly stands out. Originating in the field of pharmaceuticals, this technology was initially used as a drug delivery system to enhance the transdermal absorption of medications. However, as consumer demands for efficacy in cosmetics increased, liposome encapsulation technology gradually found its application in the skincare industry. liposomal[/caption] The basic structure of liposomes is quite simple, consisting of a bilayer of phospholipids. Phospholipids, as the main constituents of liposomes, possess excellent biocompatibility. This structure, similar to the cell membrane, endows liposomes with a strong affinity for cell membranes, making their application in skincare products more effective. The mechanism of action of liposomes primarily lies in their similarity to cell membranes. When liposomes come into contact with the skin, their membrane can fuse with the cell membrane, releasing the active ingredients contained within into the cell, thereby enhancing the absorption efficiency of active ingredients in skincare products. Additionally, liposomes can also be engulfed by cells, entering the cytoplasm to release active ingredients, further enhancing skincare efficacy. Liposome encapsulation technology offers several advantages in skincare products. Firstly, it addresses the problem of poor stability and easy inactivation of active ingredients in skincare products, ensuring the quality and efficacy of skincare products. Secondly, the vesicular structure of liposomes enhances the transdermal absorption of skincare products, making the active ingredients more easily absorbed by the skin. Furthermore, the sustained-release properties of liposomes significantly improve the efficacy and safety of skincare products. Liposome encapsulation technology[/caption] The role of liposomes in skincare products is multifaceted and profound. Firstly, the membrane structure of liposomes allows them to deliver functional ingredients directly into the cells, thereby enhancing the safety and effectiveness of skincare products. Secondly, liposomes can form complexes with proteins, sugars, and lipids on the skin surface or within the skin, helping to reduce moisture loss from the skin surface and maintain skin moisture balance. Additionally, liposomes facilitate the release and absorption of encapsulated active ingredients into the cytoplasm, further enhancing the efficacy of skincare products. In summary, as an advanced skincare technology, liposome encapsulation technology provides a new direction for the research and development of skincare products. Its role in enhancing the absorption efficiency of active ingredients, strengthening skincare efficacy, and protecting skin moisture balance is significant. With the continuous advancement of science and technology, it is believed that liposome encapsulation technology will continue to bring about more innovation and development to the skincare industry in the future. posts.excerpt: Vitamin C, also known as ascorbic acid, is a water-soluble molecule that plays a crucial role in maintaining various physiological functions. As an antioxidant, it protects the body from harmful effects of free…
posts.html:
Vitamin C, also known as ascorbic acid, is a water-soluble molecule that plays a crucial role in maintaining various physiological functions. As an antioxidant, it protects the body from harmful effects of free radicals, pollutants, and toxins. The body requires vitamin C for normal physiological functions, including nutrient synthesis and metabolism, supporting both innate and adaptive immune systems, aiding in cholesterol conversion to bile acids, and enhancing iron absorption in the intestines. Deficiency in this vitamin is often associated with conditions such as anemia, infections, gum bleeding, scurvy, poor wound healing, capillary bleeding, muscle degeneration, atherosclerotic plaque formation, and nervous system disorders. Ascorbic acid[/caption] Forms of Vitamin C Supplements:
  1. Ascorbic acid: This is the most common form of vitamin C supplement, reasonably priced, but individuals with poor gastrointestinal function may experience discomfort due to its acidic nature.
  2. Mineral ascorbates: Also known as buffered forms of vitamin C, they combine mineral salts with ascorbic acid, resulting in lower acidity. Common mineral ascorbates include sodium ascorbate, calcium ascorbate, potassium ascorbate, and magnesium ascorbate. They are recommended for individuals experiencing gastrointestinal discomfort with regular ascorbic acid supplements, but they may be more expensive.
  3. Ascorbyl Palmitate: This is a fat-soluble form of vitamin C, also known as a vitamin C ester. Unlike mineral salt forms like Ester-C®, ascorbyl palmitate is a amphiphilic molecule, meaning one end is water-soluble and the other is fat-soluble. It finds applications in food, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics and has been FDA-approved as a food-grade antioxidant.
  4. PureWay-C: This is a patented formulation of vitamin C metabolites, citrus bioflavonoids, and ascorbyl palmitate. It claims to provide better absorption, bioavailability, and cellular retention compared to other forms of vitamin C supplements. Small studies suggest that PureWay-C is absorbed more rapidly and leads to higher serum vitamin C levels and greater reductions in inflammation and oxidative stress markers compared to other forms of vitamin C such as ascorbic acid, calcium ascorbate, and Ester-C.
  5. Liposomal Vitamin C: Liposomes are micro-sized hollow spherical vesicles composed of phospholipid bilayers, with an aqueous core encapsulating hydrophilic substances such as vitamin C. They are one of the most common nanocarriers. Liposomal vitamin C absorption does not rely on vitamin C transporters like SVCT-1, but instead involves direct fusion of liposomes with intestinal cells, releasing vitamin C directly into the cells and eventually into the bloodstream. Liposomal vitamin C has higher bioavailability compared to traditional oral vitamin C supplements. Due to the substantial equipment and technology required for manufacturing, liposomal vitamin C is often more expensive than traditional vitamin C supplements.
Vitamin C[/caption] How to Distinguish Effective Liposomal Vitamin C: Both liposomal vitamin C and ascorbyl palmitate are fat-soluble forms of vitamin C. However, there is a significant difference between them. Liposomal vitamin C refers to a "liposome" form, which is a spherical structure composed of phospholipids (usually phosphatidylcholine) encapsulating vitamin C. On the other hand, ascorbyl palmitate is a "lipid-containing" form of vitamin C, which may lead to confusion with other products containing fatty acids and vitamin C. Some products labeled as "liposomal" vitamin C may not actually contain liposomes but instead may only have vitamin C covalently bonded with fatty acids. A common example is ascorbyl palmitate, which is formed by the chemical combination of palmitic acid with vitamin C, also known as esterified vitamin C. Such esterified vitamin C, like ascorbyl palmitate, is easily broken down by intestinal enzymes, releasing vitamin C (ascorbic acid molecules) and the ester. Its bioavailability is similar to that of ascorbic acid, so careful identification is necessary before purchase!

From Concept to Market: A 4-Step Guide to Herbal Supplement OEM Success

For startup brands, creating a successful herbal supplement is like navigating a complex maze. How do you go from zero to finally launching your product? This article reveals the professional OEM process step-by-step, providing a clear roadmap.

Step 1: Precise Positioning and Strategic Planning A precise start is crucial. First, you must define your specific target audience (e.g., focusing on anti-aging for women or energy enhancement for men) and accordingly determine the product type, price point, and sales channels (general trade or cross-border e-commerce). This strategic decision forms the foundation for all subsequent steps.

Step 2: Brand Building and Formula Development Next is the stage of giving the product its soul. You need to establish a unique brand positioning and image. At this stage, you can collaborate with professional teams to complete the full suite of design, from the logo to the packaging. Simultaneously, work with your OEM partner to decide on the product's specific efficacy and scientific formula, ensuring the product's core aligns perfectly with the brand image.

Step 3: Factory Selection and Compliance Filing The core production phase relies on reliable partners. A professional service provider will recommend suitable European OEM factories based on their strengths and certifications, ensuring cost-effectiveness through competitive quotes. Following this, compliance filing is the passport to market entry. Whether adopting the "General Trade" route (requiring food filing) or "Cross-Border E-commerce" (requiring submission of formula details to customs), preparing complete documentation for filing is essential to obtain the necessary sales permits.

Step 4: Production, Launch, and Global Support Finally, the product enters the formal production stage. Concurrently, your service provider can assist in obtaining the "Free Sale Certificate" in the country of origin (e.g., Europe) and ultimately support the setup of warehousing, logistics, and store launch, ensuring your brand successfully sets sail.

By systematically progressing through these four key stages, startup brands can streamline the complexity, efficiently and compliantly bridging the gap from 0 to 1, and successfully bringing a winning herbal supplement to market.
